entries.description: Free adaptive academic benchmark for children aged 6–17. Measures English, Mathematics, Verbal Reasoning, and Non-Verbal Reasoning against UK, US, PISA, and IB standards. Produces standardised scores (mean 100, SD 15) and international percentile rankings using 2PL Item Response Theory.
